loosened.reason: slimfit#13: test_seconds is now divided by the host's load slowdown (ADR 0003); re-baselined once under the new measure.
slimfit#16: the old baseline was measured with the CPU-hog test slowing the tests beside it; with it run alone, this is what the gate measures on a quiet host.
slimfit#22: the stand-in tests, which run the real binary through every preset's tools, replace the slow gate's real-toolchain Rust e2e.

slimfit#34: slimfit#31 ratcheted test_seconds before slimfit#29/#32 added 9 tests, so proving measured over its bound with no change (measurements in slimfit#40's comment "Evidence of slimfit's own baseline loosenings").

slimfit#43: test_seconds is now the tests' CPU time (ADR 0010), no longer wall time corrected for load; re-set once from a CPU-timed slimfit check of this tree under worker exclusive (measurements in slimfit#43's comments).

kept.reason: No assertion maps: it checks the mutants record (ADR 0008: unrecorded_mutants, picks, --why, picker/author, --no-mutants, merge of two records, report's mutants_records, a target gone), the other checks the growth record (ADR 0012: growth_allowance, deletions paying, justify-growth, reviewer/author, report's growth_records). The setups conflict: the other's growth_allowance = 4 makes this test's merged landing (6 lines net) fail as unrecorded_growth where it must pass, and this one's mutants_tests = All changes what the other measures; only sample_repo and the adopt commit are shared.

No assertion maps: it checks the sample (drawn names, sampled tasks, check green, report's sampled tally); the other checks a pick's first outcome. Setups conflict: the other swaps the mutation tool's outcomes file, which the sample's survivors are read from.

its time is what it checks: the real slimfit binary run ~110 times on a git copy of each of the six samples, each run driving the preset's real shell lines, git (~750 calls) and the stand-in processes on PATH; uninstrumented it is 10.8s CPU, 6.2 of it sys (spawns). A cheaper run would drop a command, a fault or a sample. Kept before (slimfit#105) at 10.49s on this same tree; refiled at 29.57s (slimfit#111) by host load alone: its share of the suite's CPU held at 46-47%
Its assertion is the pair set past shared setup (COMMON_LINES); the other test asserts the steps' text order, no pairs: nothing maps, and a merge of two 7ms tests would hide which behaviour failed
Its assertions (subset/overlap pairs, kept verdicts by suite and hash, no per-test lines => none) are unit facts of redundant(); the standins run asserts none of them
Its assertions (file grouping, ordering by seconds, share, kept tests leaving a file's task) are unit facts of redundant(); the standins run asserts none of them
It asserts the steps' and help's order and accept text; the other test asserts setup pairs only: nothing maps, and the setups differ
It asserts per-binary setup exclusion; the other asserts the steps' text: nothing maps, a merge would hide which behaviour failed
It asserts a setup-only subset across binaries is not proposed, on a different suite than the other test's; folding the setups changes what each pair set is
It asserts cap()'s per-kind per-suite limit; the other test asserts the empty answer of main: nothing maps

kept_files.reason: Already deep: main reaches it through four calls (all, sampled, candidates, cap) and keep through two (source_suite, churn); behind them each task kind's finder and its steps are private and live together, so a new kind or a reworded recipe lands in one place. The churn is that: step texts and new kinds, not callers reaching in. Splitting per kind into submodules would spread the TaskKind/Task/cap contract without hiding more behind it; the redundant-test overlap and trend reading are already single private functions with their own tests through the same Task output.

kept_spans.reason: Runs only after measuring the tree a change starts from (a git worktree and that suite's real test run) when that run recorded no lines per test (a suite with no reach report): no fast test reaches it, and the warning plus skip it decides is visible only through that real run.
